title: Slim Gaillard and Slam Stewart
summary: They talk about Slim Gaillard as a dependable but unpredictable entertainer, and Slam Stewart's teaching and reunion with Benny Goodman.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Slim was sort off a fixture there, wasn't he.
Yes, he was. Yes. I don't really know what happened to him. He'd show up for a while, and then disappear!
Well, he's such a great all-around entertainer and everything.
Yeah, he's done a lot of things, didn't he. Him and Slam Stewart.
Well, Slam is established, I guess.

Yes, he's teaching. And he works. He's been working with Benny quite a bit over the past year-and-a-half or so. But Benny I guess didn't speak to him for about fifteen years or something, and then suddenly they got together again. Slim had a lot of things that remind me of Leo Watson a bit...
